selection_rationale: New fōt, brycg, hęre and ēðel systems are literal. Further sharing is confined to the source-audited declension family, identical complete slots, explicit diagnostic stems and exact successful surface derivation for every cell. Every failed match remains a literal full table. The final recorded model choices are individually reviewed.
